question: In a certain coded language 'RAKED' is coded as 'GINEU' and 'DELVE' is coded as 'HZOIG'. How will 'CARRY' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eb76a2bd0f8cd29c921339098eb5c02f1ee21211a2ccae29bc574791b6b3fa4.png] **

'RAKED' is coded as 'GINEU',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c23c9323be583f0dc0c9d548482d9e797050d38ce20c41401c5fa1b65edd338.png] 

'DELVE' is coded as 'HZOIG'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a728f829feb0e39d1e169ee291c3a3176a457a20f097dfdd22e0158a992af85.png] 

Similarly,

'CARRY' be coded as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/154ad463964d7533b55f6d01807bd6f5a36106ca889b079746562326051e5a7f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.
